configurePresets.name: windows-vcpkg
configurePresets.description: Requires the VCPKG_ROOT environment variable to point at a local vcpkg checkout. Visual Studio's Open Folder / CMake integration only supports the Ninja generators, not the 'Visual Studio ...' generators.

configurePresets.name: windows-vcpkg-vs2022
configurePresets.displayName: Windows (MSVC v143 / VS2022, vcpkg, Ninja Multi-Config, Qt6)
configurePresets.description: Same as 'windows-vcpkg', pinned to the VS2022 v143 toolset (this machine also has a newer VS install whose default toolset is not Qt-ABI-compatible with prebuilt Qt6 'msvc2022_64' binaries, so the toolset must be pinned explicitly). Needs a Qt6 'msvc2022_64' kit: point CMake at it per-machine by setting the 'Qt6_DIR' environment variable to '<your Qt6 kit>/lib/cmake/Qt6' (CMake's own find_package(Qt6) convention) -- intentionally not recorded here so this file has no machine-specific path.
